'''Albert Klein''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 4th at [[March 2001 Centerville tournament]] on 24 March 2001 with [[My Kind Of Scum / Fearless And Inventive|MKOS alien mains]], according to Tyler Martin's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1945">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-24-centerville-ohio-3-24-01d1945/ centerville-ohio-3-24-01], DeckTech (Tyler "231" Martin, 24 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-24-centerville-ohio-3-24-01d1945/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
